description: Weight sets for scoring. Subjective preferences live here, never in code, so the owners can move them and see rankings change (master prompt sections 38 and 57). Rankings are only comparable within a single weight set.

preference_axes._comment: The trade-offs the owners can dial. Each named weight set below is a position on these axes; the dashboard exposes them as sliders.
preference_axes.return_vs_lifestyle: How much personal enjoyment is traded for financial return
preference_axes.cheap_entry_vs_premium: Low acquisition cost versus better asset quality
preference_axes.turnkey_vs_renovation: Ready to operate versus value-add work
preference_axes.town_life_vs_ski_proximity: Amenity and atmosphere versus distance to lifts

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.description: Neutral starting point pending owner preferences. Deliberately not treated as 'correct' — it is a default, not a recommendation.

pure_investment.label: Pure investment
pure_investment.description: Return-maximising. Lifestyle factors weighted only insofar as they drive guest demand.

lifestyle.label: Lifestyle first
lifestyle.description: Weighted toward what the owners would enjoy using, while still requiring the operation to be lawful and manageable.

emerging_upside.label: Emerging upside
emerging_upside.description: Seeks earlier-stage markets. Deliberately paired with a high risk weight: emerging markets are cheap for reasons, and this profile must not be allowed to reward optimism.

low_risk.label: Low risk
low_risk.description: Prioritises evidenced, liquid, well-serviced markets over upside.

owner_preference_status.note: No owner preference has been recorded. 'balanced' is used as a neutral default and must not be presented as the owners' chosen profile. See ASSUMPTIONS.md A4 and outputs/next-actions.md.
